page_title: AUX 1-0 TOU | Auxerre v Toulouse 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+4' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Marc Bollengier ignores the protests.
90+3' Auxerre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
85' Christophe Pelissier decides to make a substitution. Lassine Sinayoko will be replaced by Assane Diousse (Auxerre).
85' The referee signals a corner kick to Toulouse.
83' Today's referee Marc Bollengier rightly decides to book Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) for his harsh tackle.
82' The substitution is prepared. Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yann Gboho.
82' A yellow card for a tackle by Mark McKenzie (Toulouse). Marc Bollengier doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
79' NO PENALTY! Referee Marc Bollengier has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Auxerre players are incensed.
76' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Auxerre, he's going to review using VAR.
76' A clumsy foul by Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle. No point in arguing there. Auxerre will take a penalty kick.
70' The referee signals a substitution. Mario Sauer (Toulouse) is brought on as a substitute for Abu Francis.
70' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) replacing Rasmus Nicolaisen.
65' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sekou Mara.
64' Referee Marc Bollengier seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre).

64' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre), but referee Marc Bollengier must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
62' Booking. Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) receives a caution from the referee.
56' A substitution has been made. Noah Edjouma is replaced by Emersonn (Toulouse).
56' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Dayann Methalie is replaced by Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
54' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
50' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' 1 - 0 Danny Namaso (Auxerre) puts the ball in the back of the net!
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Toulouse are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
35' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) gets booked for the first time in this match.
30' Auxerre get a corner.
29' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guillaume Restes, who smothers the ball.
27' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
25' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) sends the corner into the box, but Donovan Leon intercepts it and averts the threat.
24' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Toulouse will take a corner.
24' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
23' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar.
21' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marc Bollengier signals.

19' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
17' The Auxerre players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
11' Auxerre fail to score from a corner as Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) leaps to collect the ball.
3' Frank Magri (Toulouse) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the right side of the target, but Donovan Leon pulls off a superb save.
3' Frank Magri (Toulouse) is going to take the penalty!
3' It’s a PENALTY to Toulouse after the VAR review!

3' Play continues despite the shouts by some Toulouse players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Marc Bollengier interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
2' Surely that's handball by one of the Auxerre players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
1' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier will officiate today.
